privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: BioMath Core ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal and health information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your data when you use our wellness intelligence service.
body: note:gray|Important Notice

p|BioMath Core provides educational information and personalized insights. We are NOT a medical service provider, healthcare provider, or covered entity under HIPAA. We do NOT diagnose, treat, or provide medical advice. Our service is designed for wellness optimization and preventive health support only.
/note
h2|1. Information We Collect
h3|1.1 Personal Information
li|**Account Information:** name, email address, username, password (encrypted)
li|**Contact Details:** phone number, mailing address (optional)
li|**Billing Information:** payment card details (processed securely through third-party payment processors), billing address
li|**Profile Information:** date of birth, gender, time zone, preferences
li|**Communication Records:** support tickets, feedback, survey responses
h3|1.2 Health and Wellness Data
li|**Self-Reported Data:** health questionnaire responses, wellness goals, lifestyle information
li|**Biomarker Data:** lab results you choose to upload (blood work, metabolic panels, and similar)
li|**Wearable Device Data:** activity, sleep, heart rate, and other metrics from connected devices (Fitbit, Apple Watch, and others)
li|**Health Assessments:** symptom tracking, mood logs, energy levels
li|**Health Guide Interactions:** your questions and conversations with the Health Guide
h3|1.3 Technical Information
li|**Device Information:** IP address, browser type, operating system, device identifiers
li|**Usage Data:** pages visited, features used, time spent, click patterns
li|**Cookies and Tracking:** session cookies, preference cookies, analytics cookies
li|**Location Data:** approximate location based on IP address (not precise GPS)
h2|2. How We Use Your Information
p|We use your information for the following purposes:
h3|2.1 Service Provision
li|Generate personalized health insights and wellness recommendations
li|Create health reports and trend analysis
li|Process and display data from connected devices
li|Provide second opinion analysis services
li|Enable goal tracking and progress monitoring
h3|2.2 Service Improvement
li|Train and improve our models and algorithms
li|Conduct research on wellness patterns using aggregated, anonymized data
li|Test new features and services
li|Analyze usage patterns to enhance the user experience
h3|2.3 Communication
li|Send service updates and important notifications
li|Respond to support requests and inquiries
li|Deliver educational content and wellness tips
li|Send marketing communications (with your consent; opt-out available)
h3|2.4 Legal and Security
li|Comply with legal obligations and regulatory requirements
li|Prevent fraud, abuse, and security threats
li|Enforce our Terms of Service
li|Protect the rights and safety of our users and BioMath Core
h2|3. Data Sharing and Disclosure
p|**We do NOT sell your personal data.** We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
h3|3.1 With Your Consent
p|We will share your information when you explicitly authorize us to do so, such as:
li|Sharing data with healthcare providers you designate
li|Exporting your data to third-party health apps
li|Participating in research studies (opt-in only)
h3|3.2 Service Providers
p|We engage trusted third-party service providers who help us operate our service:
li|**Cloud Infrastructure:** Supabase, AWS, Google Cloud (secure data hosting)
li|**Payment Processing:** Stripe (we do not store full credit card details)
li|**Analytics:** Google Analytics (anonymized data only)
li|**Customer Support:** support ticketing systems
li|**Email Services:** transactional email providers
p|All service providers are contractually bound to maintain confidentiality and security standards.
h3|3.3 Legal Requirements
p|We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to:
li|Valid legal process (subpoena, court order)
li|Government or regulatory requests
li|Investigations of fraud or illegal activity
li|Emergencies involving potential harm to individuals
h3|3.4 Business Transfers

p|In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred to the acquiring entity. We will notify you by email and with a prominent notice in the product before any such transfer occurs.
h2|4. Data Security
p|We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your information:
h3|Technical Safeguards
li|**Encryption:** 256-bit AES encryption for data at rest; TLS 1.3 for data in transit
li|**Access Controls:** role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA)
li|**Infrastructure:** SOC 2 Type II certified cloud providers
li|**Monitoring:** 24/7 security monitoring, intrusion detection systems
li|**Testing:** regular penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
h3|Organizational Safeguards
li|Employee background checks and confidentiality agreements
li|Least-privilege access policies
li|Regular security training for staff
li|Incident response and breach notification procedures
p|While we employ strong security practices, no system is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security, but we are committed to protecting your data to the best of our ability.
h2|5. Your Privacy Rights
p|You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
h3|5.1 Access and Portability
li|Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
li|Export your data in a machine-readable format (JSON, CSV)
li|View and download your health reports and insights
h3|5.2 Correction and Update
li|Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
li|Update your profile and preferences at any time
h3|5.3 Deletion
li|Request deletion of your account and associated data
li|Delete specific data points or entries
li|Note: some data may be retained for legal compliance, such as billing records
h3|5.4 Restrict or Object
li|Restrict processing of certain data
li|Object to automated decision-making
li|Opt out of marketing communications
h3|5.5 Withdraw Consent
p|Where we process data based on consent, you may withdraw consent at any time. This will not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
p|To exercise any of these rights, contact us at **privacy@biomathcore.com**. We will respond within 30 days.
h2|6. Data Retention
p|We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide services and comply with legal obligations:
li|**Active Accounts:** data retained while the account is active
li|**Deleted Accounts:** most data deleted within 90 days; some data retained for legal compliance (financial records: 7 years)
li|**Anonymized Data:** aggregated, anonymized data may be retained indefinitely for research
li|**Backups:** backup copies deleted within 90 days of account deletion
h2|7. Cookies and Tracking
p|We use cookies and similar technologies:
li|**Essential Cookies:** required for core functionality (authentication, security)
li|**Functional Cookies:** remember preferences and settings
li|**Analytics Cookies:** understand usage patterns (opt-out available)
li|**Marketing Cookies:** deliver relevant content (opt-out available)
p|You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie banner.
h2|8. Children's Privacy

p|BioMath Core is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, we will delete it immediately. If you believe a child has provided information, contact us at privacy@biomathcore.com.
h2|9. International Data Transfers

p|BioMath Core is based in the United States. If you access our services from outside the U.S., your information will be transferred to and processed in the U.S. By using our services, you consent to this transfer.
p|For users in the European Economic Area (EEA), we comply with GDPR requirements and use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for data transfers.
h2|10. Changes to This Policy
p|We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes take effect upon posting. Material changes will be communicated through:
li|Email notification to registered users
li|A prominent notice in the product
li|An updated "last modified" date at the top of this policy
p|Your continued use of BioMath Core after changes indicates acceptance of the updated policy.
h2|11. Contact Us
p|For questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information:
note:gray|

p|**BioMath Core**
Privacy Officer

p|**Email:** privacy@biomathcore.com
**Support:** support@biomathcore.com
/note

outro.title: Questions About Privacy?
outro.text: Our Privacy Officer is here to help. Contact us at privacy@biomathcore.com

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
intro: This disclaimer governs your use of BioMath Core. By using our service, you acknowledge and agree to this disclaimer. If you do not agree, discontinue use immediately.
body: h2|1. Not Medical Advice
note:orange|BioMath Core is NOT a medical service, healthcare provider, or covered entity under HIPAA.
p|The information, content, insights, and recommendations provided through BioMath Core are for:
li|**Educational purposes only**
li|**Wellness optimization guidance**
li|**General health information**
li|**Personal research and knowledge**
p|**Our Service does NOT:**
li|Provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment
li|Replace consultation with qualified healthcare professionals
li|Create doctor-patient relationships
li|Prescribe medications, therapies, or medical treatments
li|Provide emergency medical services
li|Offer clinical medical opinions
/note
h2|2. Consult Healthcare Professionals
p|**ALWAYS seek the advice of your physician or another qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding:**
li|Medical conditions or symptoms
li|Lab results or biomarker interpretations
li|Treatment options or medications
li|Dietary or lifestyle changes
li|Exercise programs or physical activity
li|Supplement use or dosages
p|**NEVER disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you have read or learned through BioMath Core.**
h2|3. Emergency Situations
note:red|IF YOU THINK YOU MAY HAVE A MEDICAL EMERGENCY, CALL 911 OR YOUR LOCAL EMERGENCY NUMBER IMMEDIATELY.
p|BioMath Core is NOT an emergency service. Do not use it for emergency situations or time-sensitive medical questions.

p|Signs requiring immediate medical attention include, but are not limited to: chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, loss of consciousness, stroke symptoms, and severe allergic reactions.
/note
h2|4. No Professional Relationship
p|Use of BioMath Core does NOT create a doctor-patient, therapist-patient, or any other healthcare professional relationship between you and BioMath Core, its employees, contractors, or partners.
p|Any communication through the service is for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute professional medical advice.
h2|5. Model and Algorithm Limitations
p|BioMath Core uses models and algorithms to analyze data and provide insights. However:
li|Models can make errors and may not account for all individual factors
li|Algorithms are not substitutes for professional medical judgment
li|Technology has limitations and may not detect all health issues
li|Results should be verified by qualified healthcare professionals
li|Insights are general and may not apply to your specific situation
h3|Health Guide
p|Health Guide is the conversational feature inside BioMath Core. It explains your own data in plain language. It cannot examine you, and it knows nothing you have not shared with it.
li|Health Guide answers are generated automatically and can be incomplete or wrong
li|Health Guide does not assess symptoms and must never be used in an emergency
li|Health Guide does not replace a conversation with your own clinician
li|Verify anything that could change your care with a qualified healthcare professional
h2|6. Accuracy and Completeness
p|While we strive for accuracy, BioMath Core makes no representations or warranties about:
li|The accuracy, reliability, or completeness of any information
li|The suitability of information for your individual circumstances
li|How current medical knowledge or recommendations are
li|The interpretation of wearable device data or biomarkers
p|Medical science evolves constantly. Information that is current today may be outdated tomorrow.
h2|7. Individual Variability

p|Every individual is unique. What works for one person may not work for another. Health recommendations must be personalized by qualified healthcare professionals who understand your complete medical history, current conditions, and individual circumstances.
h2|8. Third-Party Content

p|BioMath Core may include content from third parties, links to external websites, or integration with third-party devices. We are not responsible for the accuracy, reliability, or content of such third-party information or services.
h2|9. Assumption of Risk
p|By using BioMath Core, you acknowledge and agree that:
li|You use the Service at your own risk
li|You are responsible for any decisions or actions you take based on the information provided
li|You will consult healthcare professionals before making health-related decisions
li|BioMath Core is not liable for any outcomes resulting from use of the Service
h2|10. Regulatory Status
p|BioMath Core is a wellness service and is not regulated as a medical device by the FDA or other regulatory agencies. Our Service is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
h2|11. Changes to This Disclaimer
p|We may update this disclaimer at any time. Continued use of BioMath Core after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated disclaimer. Check this page regularly for updates.
h2|12. Contact Information
note:gray|

p|**BioMath Core**
Legal Department
**Email:** legal@biomathcore.com
/note

hipaaNotice.title: HIPAA Notice
intro: This notice explains BioMath Core's relationship with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and how it affects your use of our service.
body: h2|1. BioMath Core is NOT a HIPAA Covered Entity
note:orange|IMPORTANT NOTICE
p|BioMath Core is NOT a healthcare provider, health plan, or healthcare clearinghouse. Therefore, we are NOT a "Covered Entity" under HIPAA regulations.
p|The health information you provide to BioMath Core is NOT protected by HIPAA. Instead, your information is protected by our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.
/note
h2|2. What is HIPAA?
p|The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) is a United States federal law that protects the privacy and security of health information held by:
li|**Healthcare Providers:** doctors, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies
li|**Health Plans:** insurance companies, HMOs, Medicare, Medicaid
li|**Healthcare Clearinghouses:** entities that process health information
p|BioMath Core does not fall into any of these categories.
h2|3. How Your Information is Protected
p|While HIPAA does not apply to BioMath Core, we take data protection seriously. Your information is protected by:
li|**Our Privacy Policy:** governs the collection, use, and disclosure of your data
li|**Strong Security Measures:** 256-bit encryption, secure servers, access controls
li|**Limited Data Sharing:** we do NOT sell your personal data
li|**User Control:** you can access, export, and delete your data
li|**Applicable Laws:** we comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws
p|For details, see our Privacy Policy and Security documentation.
h2|4. Voluntary Data Submission
p|All health information you provide to BioMath Core is **voluntary**. By using our Service:
li|You choose what information to share
li|You consent to our use of your data as described in our Privacy Policy
li|You understand that HIPAA protections do not apply
li|You accept the terms of our data protection practices
h2|5. Healthcare Provider Integration
p|If you choose to share data with your healthcare provider through BioMath Core:
li|Your healthcare provider IS a HIPAA Covered Entity
li|Once shared, that data becomes part of your medical record
li|HIPAA protections apply to data held by your healthcare provider
li|Your provider's HIPAA Notice governs that data
h2|6. Data from HIPAA Covered Entities
p|If you upload health data from HIPAA Covered Entities, such as lab results from your doctor:
li|You are voluntarily sharing that data with BioMath Core
li|HIPAA protections apply only while the data is held by the Covered Entity
li|Once you upload it to BioMath Core, our Privacy Policy applies
li|We handle this data with the same high security standards as all other data
h2|7. No Business Associate Agreement

p|BioMath Core does not enter into Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) with healthcare providers unless specifically contracted for enterprise services. For individual users, no BAA exists, and HIPAA regulations do not apply to our relationship.
h2|8. Your Rights
p|Under our Privacy Policy, you have rights similar to HIPAA rights:
li|**Access:** request a copy of your data
li|**Correction:** update inaccurate information
li|**Deletion:** request deletion of your data
li|**Portability:** export your data in a machine-readable format
li|**Restriction:** limit certain data processing
p|Contact privacy@biomathcore.com to exercise these rights.
h2|9. State Privacy Laws

p|Depending on your location, additional privacy laws may apply, such as the CCPA in California or the GDPR in Europe. BioMath Core complies with applicable state and international privacy regulations. See our Privacy Policy for details.
h2|10. Questions and Contact
p|For questions about HIPAA, data protection, or privacy:
note:gray|

p|**BioMath Core**
Privacy Officer
**Email:** privacy@biomathcore.com
**Support:** support@biomathcore.com
/note

outro.title: Summary
outro.text: BioMath Core is NOT covered by HIPAA, but we protect your health information through strong security measures, transparent privacy practices, and compliance with applicable data protection laws.

security.title: Security
intro: BioMath Core takes security seriously. This page explains the technical and organizational measures we use to protect your data.
body: h2|1. Data Encryption
li|**Data at Rest:** 256-bit AES encryption for all stored data
li|**Data in Transit:** TLS 1.3 encryption for all data transmissions
li|**Database Encryption:** full database encryption with rotating keys
li|**Password Protection:** bcrypt hashing with salt for all passwords
li|**Backups:** encrypted backups stored in secure locations
h2|2. Access Controls
li|**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):** strict permission systems
li|**Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA):** required for administrative access
li|**Least Privilege Principle:** employees have the minimum necessary access
li|**Regular Audits:** quarterly access reviews and revocations
li|**Session Management:** automatic timeout after inactivity
h2|3. Infrastructure Security
li|**Cloud Providers:** SOC 2 Type II certified (Supabase, AWS, Google Cloud)
li|**Network Security:** firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems
li|**DDoS Protection:** enterprise-grade protection against attacks
li|**Load Balancing:** distributed infrastructure for reliability
li|**Redundancy:** multi-region backups and failover systems
h2|4. Application Security
li|**Secure Development:** security best practices in code
li|**Input Validation:** all user input is sanitized and validated
li|**SQL Injection Prevention:** parameterized queries only
li|**XSS Protection:** Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
li|**CSRF Protection:** token-based request validation
li|**API Security:** rate limiting and required authentication
h2|5. Monitoring and Detection
li|**24/7 Monitoring:** real-time security monitoring
li|**Intrusion Detection:** automated threat detection systems
li|**Log Management:** comprehensive logging and analysis
li|**Anomaly Detection:** automated detection of unusual activity
li|**Incident Response:** a dedicated security incident team
h2|6. Testing and Audits
li|**Penetration Testing:** annual third-party security audits
li|**Vulnerability Scanning:** continuous automated scanning
li|**Code Reviews:** a security-focused code review process
li|**Dependency Monitoring:** automated vulnerability tracking
li|**Compliance Audits:** regular compliance assessments
h2|7. Employee Security
li|**Background Checks:** required for all employees
li|**Security Training:** mandatory annual security training
li|**Confidentiality Agreements:** all employees sign NDAs
li|**Device Security:** encrypted devices and required security software
li|**Termination Procedures:** immediate access revocation
h2|8. Data Backup and Recovery
li|**Regular Backups:** automated daily encrypted backups
li|**Off-Site Storage:** geographically distributed backup locations
li|**Disaster Recovery:** tested recovery procedures
li|**Business Continuity:** plans for service continuity
li|**Data Retention:** secure deletion after the retention period
h2|9. Incident Response
p|In the event of a security incident:
li|Immediate containment and investigation
li|Notification to affected users within 72 hours
li|Coordination with law enforcement if necessary
li|Post-incident analysis and improvements
li|Transparent communication about the incident
h2|10. Your Security Responsibilities
p|Help us keep your account secure:
li|Use a strong, unique password
li|Enable two-factor authentication
li|Keep your devices secure and updated
li|Never share your password
li|Report suspicious activity immediately
li|Log out from shared or public devices
h2|11. Security Certifications and Compliance
li|Infrastructure hosted on SOC 2 Type II certified providers
li|GDPR-compliant data processing
li|CCPA compliance for California users
li|Regular security audits and assessments
li|Industry-standard security practices
h2|12. Reporting Security Issues
p|If you discover a security vulnerability:
note:gray|

p|**Security Team**
**Email:** security@biomathcore.com
**Response Time:** within 24 hours
p|We appreciate responsible disclosure and will work with security researchers to address issues promptly.
/note

outro.title: Questions About Security?
outro.text: Our security team is here to help.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance
intro: BioMath Core complies with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This page explains your rights and how we protect your data.
body: h2|1. GDPR Overview
p|The GDPR is a comprehensive data protection law that applies to organizations processing personal data of EU and EEA residents. BioMath Core respects your privacy rights under the GDPR.
h2|2. Your GDPR Rights
h3|Right of Access
p|You can request a copy of all personal data we hold about you. We will provide it in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
h3|Right to Rectification
p|You can correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
h3|Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")
p|You can request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention requirements.
h3|Right to Restriction of Processing
p|You can ask us to limit how we use your data.
h3|Right to Data Portability
p|You can receive your data in a portable format and transmit it to another service.
h3|Right to Object
p|You can object to the processing of your data for marketing or other purposes.
h3|Right to Withdraw Consent
p|You can withdraw consent for data processing at any time.
h3|Right to Lodge a Complaint
p|You can file a complaint with your local data protection authority.
h2|3. Legal Basis for Processing
p|We process your data on the following bases:
li|**Consent:** you have given explicit consent for processing
li|**Contract:** processing is necessary to fulfill our service agreement
li|**Legitimate Interests:** service improvement and security
li|**Legal Obligation:** compliance with applicable laws
h2|4. Data Transfers
p|BioMath Core is based in the United States. When we transfer your data outside the EU and EEA:
li|We use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
li|We ensure adequate data protection measures
li|We comply with GDPR requirements for international transfers
h2|5. Data Retention
p|We retain your data only as long as necessary:
li|**Active accounts:** while your account is active
li|**Deleted accounts:** most data deleted within 90 days
li|**Legal requirements:** some data retained for compliance (for example, financial records: 7 years)
li|**Anonymized data:** may be retained indefinitely for research
h2|6. Data Protection Officer
p|For GDPR-related questions or to exercise your rights:
note:gray|

p|**Data Protection Officer**
BioMath Core
**Email:** dpo@biomathcore.com
**Privacy email:** privacy@biomathcore.com
/note
h2|7. Exercising Your Rights
p|To exercise any GDPR right:
li|Email dpo@biomathcore.com or privacy@biomathcore.com
li|We will verify your identity to protect your data
li|We will respond within 30 days (extendable to 90 days for complex requests)
li|We will provide the requested information free of charge
h2|8. Supervisory Authority
p|You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority if you believe we have violated the GDPR:
p|Find your local data protection authority at **https://edpb.europa.eu/about-edpb/board/members_en**

outro.title: Questions About GDPR?
outro.text: Contact our Data Protection Officer for assistance.
